newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chirac staff dismiss cabinet reshuffle rumours.
newsitem.headline: Chirac staff dismiss cabinet reshuffle rumours.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac's staff dismissed rumours circulating in parliament in Paris of an imminent reshuffle of Prime Minister Alain Juppe's unpopular centre-right government, possibly as early as next weekend.

A presidential aide said he had put the rumours to Chirac in Tokyo on Tuesday who had dismissed them with a wave of the hand. Rumours among parliamentarians debating the 1997 budget centred on the possible replacement of Finance Minister Jean Arthuis and Interior Minister Jean-Louis Debre.
